description: A small release-performance profile. These are workloads, not substitutes for the complete browser parity corpus.

cases.source:
A = matrix(ZZ, 12, 12, lambda i,j: (i+2)*(j+3) + (1 if i == j else 0))
print(A.det())
print(A.hermite_form()[0,0])

R.<x> = QQ[]
K.<a> = NumberField(x^3-x-1)
O = K.maximal_order()
coefficients = K.zeta_function().coefficients(1000)
print(O.discriminant(), len(coefficients), sum(coefficients[:32]))

points = [CC(2, k/8) for k in range(-16,17)]
R = RiemannZeta(80)
G = DirichletGroup(5)
D = G[2].lfunction(80)
P.<x> = PolynomialRing(QQ)
K.<a> = NumberField(x^2 - 5)
Z = K.zeta_function(prec=80)
values = R.values(points) + D.values(points) + Z.values(points)
print(len(values), float(values[0].real()), float(values[-1].real()))

E = EllipticCurve([0,0,1,-1,0])
L = E.lseries()
points = [CC(1, k/8) for k in range(-16,17)]
values = L.values(points, prec=53)
print(len(values), float(values[0].real()), float(values[-1].imag()))
